findings: Single-exit, nonnested SM4 loops are lowered to bounded conditional execution with a provider-side overflow check after 16 iterations. General unbounded or nested loops remain unsupported.

FRC, GE and signed IGE pass 768 direct NPU arithmetic components. GE flushes denormals as required by SM4. Splitting integer comparisons into high/low parts avoids a CPU provider comparison mismatch above 2^24.

NPU FRC failed because large floating comparison constants were demoted. A scaled guard and explicit IsInf/IsNaN preserve the qualified results, including large fractional values and nonfinite inputs.

The captured mirrored filter originally expanded from 224 instructions to 3395. CPU qualification took about seven minutes; the corresponding v151 NPU attempt was deliberately canceled after 496873 ms without a result, not labeled a timeout or correctness failure.

An exact-bytecode specialization evaluates independent mirrored sample pairs along a 128-tap axis and reduces on the provider. Host code admits at most 128 coefficients and copies inputs; it does not evaluate pixels. Summation order differs, so scalar comparisons use an explicit 1e-5 absolute tolerance.

Native ReduceSum reduced precision. A rank-three axis-one Gather/Add reduction produced incorrect outputs. Flat row Gather/Add passes the scalar reference. The diagnostic per-tap comparison checks 67584 components; 23 of 33 cases are byte exact and the maximum difference is 4.470348358154297e-8.

The v157 512-pixel specialization expanded to 65536 tap lanes and lost the NPU device during raster inference. A subsequent fresh arithmetic process passed without a restart. Smaller 64- and 256-pixel raster batches passed. The shipped bound is 256 pixels, expanding to 32768 tap lanes.
Diagnostic v144 and v155/v158 builds intentionally disabled mismatch assertions to collect failures; their printed component labels and exit status are not qualification passes.

Build v139 failed /WX shadowing; v140 exposed integer comparison error; v148 first failed from a diagnostic PATH error, then its rounding-bias candidate failed CPU arithmetic. v162 scratch build failed from duplicate header identities. Failed logs and sources remain preserved.

The observer now takes bounded snapshots of growing logs instead of reading through concurrent appends. A separate test completed 100 snapshots while the writer grew the file and rejected an oversized log.
These are component, raster, DDI and packet checks. Installed desktop behavior, physical scanout and a Tahoma benefit remain unproven for this change.
